description: Puntos de acceso WIFI públicos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. Location of free internet access points in the municipality. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. The portal shows the English title as "Public WIFI access points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Pozuelo de Alarcón. Its keywords include WIFI. The listing shows 2025-03-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendefinition.org/od/2.1/en/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
